categories.evidence: Carries the Block storage label and modifies block storage initialization logic in src/node/blockstorage.cpp.
categories.rationale: Prevents destructive data loss where a missing `xor.dat` causes the node to overwrite existing obfuscated block data during reindexing. When `xor.dat` is absent, the node currently writes an all-zero key and prompts a `-reindex`, which partially overwrites `blk00000.dat` and resets the chain to height 0; aborting with an actionable error preserves intact block files so users can restore the key.
